annotations.title: Change a document by its link

description: Writes a new version of a document by its link — e.g. the person asks in the chat to remove something on page 2 — and prints it again: the PDF link, the same edit link (the editor open on it shows the change). Send the whole new html (and data, if it is a template), changed from what get_document returned, with base_revision: a document the person changed after you read it is refused, so read it again.

base_revision.description: The revision you read (get_document, or the last result). Required: a document the person changed after it is refused, never overwritten.

data.description: The template's new data. Alone, only for a template (kind "template"); with html, non-empty data makes the document a template. Omitted: the data stays.

filename.description: A new PDF file name, kept for its later prints. Default: the name it was printed with (render_pdf filename), else its <title>.

html.description: The whole new source. Omitted: the source stays (e.g. new data only).

preview.description: A picture (PNG) of page 1 comes with the answer, so you can check the layout, fonts and images before giving the links. Default: true.

name: update_document
